children: Swiss running-shoe maker On Holding will host an investor day on Tuesday, marking its first such event since October 2023, according to William Blair. "The event will serve as an important opportunity for founders and newly appointed co-CEOs, David Allemann and Caspar Coppetti, to set expectations and provide greater clarity on the company's next three-year growth framework," the analysts say in a research note. The event comes as investors have become increasingly concerned about the company, which is seeing sales growth decelerate and competition in the athletic footwear market mount. As a result, the analysts say On should take on a more sober view of its wholesale channel and issue more muted guidance. "We would look to get more constructive with expectations reset and a more achievable bar set," they say. (connor.hart@wsj.com)
